## Problem and result

Explain what prompted the change and what someone can now do or observe.
Link the related issue (`Closes #...` only when this PR completes it).

## Validation

List the exact commands run and their results. Mention checks not run and why.
Include screenshots for interface changes and reproduction steps for fixes.

## Evidence and scope

Describe changed source inputs, scientific interpretation, generated artifacts,
or package contracts, if applicable. State remaining limitations; write N/A for
changes that do not affect these areas.

## Ready for review

- [ ] I read the [contribution guide](https://github.com/DenBraun/Onto2D/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The change is focused and updates the relevant documentation.
- [ ] Behavior changes have meaningful tests, or I explained why they are unnecessary.
- [ ] Third-party sources retain attribution and their terms; no credentials or private data are included.
